notes.title: New version Update!
notes.content:
𝘛𝘩𝘦 𝘣𝘪𝘨𝘨𝘦𝘴𝘵 𝘶𝘱𝘥𝘢𝘵𝘦 𝘦𝘷𝘦𝘳 𝘰𝘯 𝘔𝘦𝘵𝘢𝘋𝘖𝘚  
💥  𝗚𝗲𝗻𝗲𝗿𝗮𝗹 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
 - Added Skydive actions
 - Added attachment system, starting with optics
 - Improved Revive system
 - Improved Aim Down Sight experience
 - Added camera shaking effect when you sprint
 - Added Skin system

💥  𝗨𝗜/𝗨𝗫 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
 - Improved main menu (home screen) to make it clean and easy to navigate.
 - Improved Inventory UX & UI

💥 𝗣𝗹𝗮𝘆𝗲𝗿 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
Remake Terra Player to make it suitable for our quality game.

💥 𝗪𝗲𝗮𝗽𝗼𝗻 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
 - Added APC9 Pro submachine gun, a lightweight and effective SMG.
- Added Origin-12 shotgun, a long-range shotgun.

💥 𝗠𝗮𝗽 𝗨𝗽𝗱𝗮𝘁𝗲𝘀
 - Improved water system
 - Added new zones
 - Added new constructions

💥 𝗕𝘂𝗴 𝗙𝗶𝘅𝗲𝘀
